versions.changelog:
- Initial release of master-tsongkhapa skill for responding to user queries about Gelugpa (格鲁派), Lamrim (道次第), Tsongkhapa, and related Tibetan Buddhist doctrines.
- Ensures all doctrinal statements are accompanied by precise Tibetan canonical citations; strictly enforces attribution rules and data boundaries.
- Integrates detailed sourcing rules, citation formats, and fallback to live FoJin API retrieval only when offline sources are insufficient and fully traceable.
- Implements strong content safeguards: no transmission of esoteric practice details, no sectarian judgments, and no mixing in non-Gelug teachings.
- Applies rigorous response requirements: neutral, citation-rich, context-sensitive answers, always concluding with further study recommendations.
